description: Figure 5 is a bar chart with the x-axis labeled "Most similar group of posts" and the y-axis labeled "Avg. like #". The x-axis has 6 categories: (90,180), (180,270), (270,360), (360,450), (450,540), and (540,630). The y-axis has a scale from 0 to 600. The bar chart shows the average number of likes for each category. The highest average number of likes is in the (90,180) category, with an average of around 550 likes. The lowest average number of likes is in the (540,630) category, with an average of around 200 likes. The other categories have average likes ranging from around 300 to 500.
